verdict.rationale: Copilot cloud agent works independently in the background. Automations can run it on a schedule or in response to repository events, which is first-party headless automation. Copilot also ships an official terminal CLI, but the evidence never shows a non-interactive or scripted mode, or use inside a CI pipeline. Missing for 10: documented non-interactive/headless CLI mode, explicit CI pipeline integration (e.g., GitHub Actions usage), hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Automations let you run Copilot cloud agent automatically, on a schedule or in response to events in a repository.
With Copilot cloud agent, GitHub Copilot can work independently in the background to complete tasks, just like a human developer.
The command-line interface (CLI) for GitHub Copilot allows you to use Copilot directly from your terminal.
